name: pmm-framework
description: A Product Marketing Director agent for teams and individuals. Starts with a guided setup and PMM health check, builds a reusable company profile from your existing work and tools, then runs the PMA 5-phase framework (Discover, Strategize, Define, Get Set, Grow) refined with MKT1 operating practices. Includes coach mode for newer PMMs and a job-hunt mode for interview preparation.
